title: A comment after a sequence item with no value stays on the item's line when the item becomes a block collection
notes: `- # c` is an item with no content, which reads as null, followed by a comment (section 6.6). Replacing it with a mapping holding a sequence writes the mapping on the lines below the dash, indented by the step of two spaces, since the document has no nested block mapping to copy (docs/edit-semantics.md, the layout of a new nested block collection). The comment is outside the value and stays. Tag `convention`, for the layout.

provenance.reference: A patch engine that moved the comment of an empty sequence item below the new collection, or dropped it.
